content:
Next year's iPhone Pro models are expected to adopt a brand-new all-glass design, coinciding with the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Today, a new leak detailed Apple's progress on this innovative model.

Here's the latest news on Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design.

Apple is just weeks away from launching its first foldable phone, the iPhone Ultra. But next year will see another unique, completely redesigned iPhone.

There are rumours that Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro models. The new device is reportedly set to feature a larger display with four-sided curved glass extending to the edges, creating a virtually bezel-less look.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital updated Apple's progress on achieving this distinctive look in a new post today.

They said Apple used the same glass assembly process as the iPhone Air, but made adjustments to use more rounded materials.

The post also mentioned improvements in two areas:

  • Thermal performance
  • Slimness

It remains difficult to determine Apple's target specifications for thickness and design materials. However, from current indications, this new phone will reference design concepts from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but won't prioritise slimness to the same degree.

Based on this latest information, we'll likely see some of the design innovations from the iPhone Air and Ultra on a model that still delivers the performance and battery life Pro users expect.

Pro users don't want to sacrifice performance for slimness. But if Apple can deliver a similar experience on a slightly slimmer model, combined with a unique all-glass aesthetic, it would be very appealing.

How interested are you in the rumoured iPhone Pro 20 model launching next year? Let us know in the comments.
